 Manchester United v Roma: Champions League – live
 Manchester United
 Roma
 Michael Carrick
 UEFA Champions League
 Roma’s Rodrigo Mora slots a pass past Manchester United's Matheus Cunha. Photograph: Scott Heppell/Reuters 
 8.14pm GMT 
 GOAL! United lose the ball in their own half and Roma move at speed, with Mora ping a pass from left to right where Soule is awaiting, helped by Dalot being dreadfully out of position. He gives Lammens the eyes and finds the bottom corner.
